messages:
maya_csm: Quick intake  Aurora Health wants to onboard a multimodal summarizer (text + scanned notes) for clinician workflows. They flagged PHI sensitivity and requested Private deployment (VPC) + audit logs. Renewal conversation next quarter so they want pilot success documented.

maya_csm: What's in scope: merged 2B checkpoint (PyTorch), OCR text preprocessor, EU residency, short SOC-style checklist, and a safety eval for PHI leakage. Pilot target: 20k summaries/day. Timeline: kickoff in 4 weeks.

hans_eng: Technical notes: we can host a 2B model on Private with dedicated capacity. OCR is pre/post pipeline so ensure input sanitization before model. Ask them to provide an example scanned doc set (de-identified) and the exact preprocessing script if custom.

rachel_ml: For safety evals: propose 3 buckets: (1) in-domain fidelity (500 pairs), (2) PHI extraction probes (100 adversarial examples), (3) hallucination/regression suite (300 prompts). Tests: token-level leak detection, membership inference on training-like snippets, and red-team reviews. Deliverable: pass/fail + short mitigations list.

nina_security: Contractwise: since PHI is involved we need their Data Processing Addendum signed and a short checklist: data residency, customer KMS (optional), access controls, audit retention (90d default), incident contact. If they want HSM keywrap for model weights well need their certs and an ops window for handshake tests.

maya_csm: They specifically asked for HSM-wrapped weights at rest and runtime unwrap inside their VPC. I told them we'd confirm feasibility.

hans_eng: Runtime unwrap is possible but requires network connectivity to their HSM or a proxy. That adds ~2 business days to validation and a small design doc. If they provide wrapped blobs only, we need to validate unwrap flow during deployment.

rachel_ml: Also ask Aurora for acceptance thresholds. E.g., "no PHI tokens reconstructed in 100 probes" or a rate cutoff. We should be explicit about what we can measure; zero risk is unrealistic.

maya_csm: I'll ask for their acceptance SLOs and for a sample of de-identified notes + a small set of synthetic PHI probes.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-5042  Aurora Health multimodal summarizer onboarding. Assignees: hans_eng, rachel_ml, nina_security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-5042

hans_eng: Action items for eng: 1) request merged checkpoint + preprocessing bundle, 2) run quick quantize/compat test (fp16 and 4-bit candidates) and measure P50/P95 on a 1k-sample harness, 3) draft runtime unwrap design if HSM requested. ETA: 3 business days after sample arrival.

rachel_ml: ML action: prepare eval harness and initial probe suite template (we'll need their labeled holdout or a representative slice). Plan to deliver an interim risk summary within 5 business days of sample.

nina_security: I'll draft the SOC-lite checklist (1p) and the DPA addendum pointer. Also note: require customer confirmation on which telemetry is allowed to leave VPC (we prefer zero).

maya_csm: I'll collect the sample uploads, signed DPA, and their SLOs. Also ask if they want canary rollout with fallback to hosted smaller summarizer for safety. That may ease renewal concerns.

hans_eng: Canary + fallback is straightforward to configure. Ops will need the routing policy and the fallback model id. If they want gradual ramping, include step sizes.

maya_csm: Perfect. I'll return with samples and SLOs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder set for CS-5042: due in 28 days.
